title: ContactPointTypeConsent - Data API
description: Represents consent for a contact point type, such as email or phone. This object is available in API version 45.0 and later.

BusinessBrandId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BusinessBrandId.description: The ID of the Business Brand that the individual has given consent to for a contact point type. this is a relationship field. This field is available in API version 53.0 and later.

CaptureContactPointType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CaptureContactPointType.description: Indicates how you captured consent. Possible values are: Email MailingAddress Phone Social Web

CaptureSource.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CaptureSource.description: Indicates how you captured consent. For example, a website or online form.

ContactPointType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ContactPointType.description: Represents the contact method you want to apply consent to. Possible values are: Email MailingAddress Phone Social Web

DataUsePurposeId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DataUsePurposeId.description: Represents the record for data use purpose that you want to associate this consent with. This is a relationship field.

DoubleConsentCaptureDate.description: Date when double opt-in was captured.

EngagementChannelType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
EngagementChannelType.description: Required if a ContactPointType isn’t selected. Represents the contact method you want to apply consent to. Possible values are: Billboard Email MailingAddress Phone SMS Social Web This is a relationship field.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Name of the contact point type consent record.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the account associated with this customer. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

PartyId.description: Represents the record based on the Individual object you want to associate consent with. This is a relationship field.

PartyRoleId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PartyRoleId.description: The ID of the Party Role for the individual you want to associate consent with. This is a polymorphic relationship field. This field is available in API version 53.0 and later.

PrivacyConsentStatus.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
PrivacyConsentStatus.description: Identify whether the individual associated with this record agrees to this form of contact. Possible values are: NotSeen Seen OptIn OptInPending—Available in API version 58.0 and later. OptOut OptOutPending—Available in API version 58.0 and later.

special_access_rules: This object is available if Data Protection and Privacy is enabled.
